propositions: A snapshot entry with issuelinks key present and a bound link must produce a confirmation record with direction=snapshot, source=snapshot, link_id from the entry id, and current pass_id
A snapshot entry with issuelinks key absent must produce no confirmation record for that issue, treating absence as unobserved rather than evidence
An authoritative empty issuelinks list must not remove or invalidate existing confirmations
A link whose source or target key is unbound to a local id must be skipped without recording or raising
Relation mapping must use link_direction.resolve_inbound_link to convert inward link types to local vocabulary, so inward Blocks is recorded as depends_on
An exception during snapshot confirmation must be caught, logged to stderr, and allow the reconcile pass to complete and persist changes
